correctness.rationale: For all positive anchors and rho, scalar G_s(r) is strictly increasing from minus to plus infinity with derivative 1+(r-s)^2(r+2s)/(rho*r^3). Its inverse maps the anchor box into itself; the exact root identity gives log derivative 3s(r-s)^2/[3s(r-s)^2+rho*a*r^2] uniformly <=q<1. W is log-sup nonexpansive; Banach gives unique fixedpoint for all finite n. A positive-equilibrium max/min principle places any other positive solution inside that box, recovering unique leadership. Monotonicity and Jx=a with offdiagonal J<=0 establish anchor order and nonfold smoothness. Exact rational algebra and finite decimal tests replayed; no ODE convergence assertion.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 paper gives only a conservative sufficient parameter condition for a unique nontrivial equilibrium. An unconditional uniqueness and constructive strict contraction for every same-sign positive anchor vector, every positive feedback ratio and all directed/reducible stochastic networks closes a real model-specific equilibrium gap and rules out positive-equilibrium folds. It provides monotone response to changed anchored opinions. At a natural two-agent contrasting-anchor example the earlier inequality fails by a factor 243 while the result still applies. This is a structural theorem for a whole parameter family, not a routine numerical illustration.
